title: Isometric chart of the orthogonal projection onto an n-plane: a 1-Lipschitz f : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → ℝⁿ with the fibres of P and Hⁿ(P(S)) = Lⁿ(f(S))
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ))), finrank ℝ W = n → ∃ f : Rn (n + ℓ) → Rn n, LipschitzWith 1 f ∧ (∀ a b : Rn (n + ℓ), f a = f b ↔ W.starProjection a = W.starProjection b) ∧ ∀ S : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), μHE[n] (W.starProjection '' S) = volume (f '' S)
